relevance_note: Family report of two maternal half-siblings with adult-onset Alexander disease carrying a GFAP exon 7A variant: "exome-NGS revealed a heterozygous variant (c.1289G > A, p.R430H) in the alternative GFAP exon 7A (Ex7A) in both patients".
method_note: Written by a Python script from my own reading; every value hand-chosen and Table 1 cells checked against the table. Table 1 has patients as columns (header '|  | Pt1 | Pt2 |'); its legend defines 0 as normal for both instrumental and clinical scores, so 0 cells were recorded as excluded with the legend quoted. MEPs/SEPs cells such as 'N.A./0/0' are per-modality values for one patient (row header Bulbar/UL/LL), not stacked multi-patient cells. Scope: Pt1 (II-2), Pt2 (II-4), the mother I-2 (GFAP c.1289G>A absent in her blood; HDAC6 heterozygous) and the other tested family members II-6, II-7, III-1 and III-3 (named as tested; GFAP variant absent by the statement 'absent ... in all other tested family members'; II-6/II-7 also HDAC6 wt). Their exact relation to the patients is not stated in text. Not given rows: the fathers I-1 and I-3 (untested, not affected; legend gives only death causes) and II-3 (died of stroke; relation not stated). Other-gene variants of Pt2/Pt1 in Additional file 6 were left out: the authors dismiss them as 'relatively frequent SNPs and/or present also in Pt1'; only HDAC6 p.P856S, which the paper attributes to Pt2 and I-2, was recorded. GFAP: the paper prints only protein reference sequences (NP_001124491.1 for GFAP-epsilon, NP_002046.1 for GFAP-alpha, NP_006035.2 for HDAC6), so transcript_as_stated is 'not reported'. GFAP inheritance left 'not reported': variant absent in the mother's blood, fathers untested; maternal germinal mosaicism is the authors' hypothesis. HDAC6 genomic position taken from the Additional file 6 row (chrX, 48681375, no build printed). Shared MRI statements about 'these patients'/'our patients' were applied to both patients as inferred from group statement; Figure 1B panels a-f are Pt1's and g is Pt2's. The Pt1 'sub-pial rim' at midbrain level is not a periventricular rim, so that checklist item is not reported. Eye movements were normal in both, but diplopia is not addressed, so the composite checklist item stays not reported. Pt2 autonomic composite left not reported (normal neurovegetative tests and sphincter score 0, but sleep apnea not addressed); Pt2 ataxia composite left not reported (axial ataxia and limb dysmetria scored 0 only). Contradictions: (1) Pt1 text says 'visual evoked potentials were altered' but Table 1 scores VEPs 0 (normal); both rows emitted. (2) Pt2: 'spastic tetraparesis ... normal strength' at 52 years, weakness at onset, and Table 1 limb weakness 2; both rows emitted and the limb weakness checklist item set to not reported. (3) Pt2: 'no muscle wasting' except temporalis at 52 years vs later hypotrophy of interosseus and tibialis anterior and Table 1 muscle wasting 1 (likely progression); both rows emitted. Pt2 was earlier diagnosed as 'primary lateral sclerosis'; disease label recorded as AOAD. Additional file 1 is a figure (not readable).

functional_evidence_statement.value: GFP-GFAP-ϵ R430H in U251-MG astrocytoma cells: decreased filamentous (43% vs 58%) and increased aggregate (22% vs 15%) cells; inefficiently incorporated, likely perturbs GFAP network
span: expression of mutant GFP-GFAP-ϵ^R430H produced significant decrease in F (43% vs. 58%; test t p = 0.002) and increase in A (22% vs. 15%; test t p = 0.009) cells
These results indicate that GFAP-ϵ^R430H is inefficiently incorporated, and is likely to perturb the GFAP network in GFAP-expressing astrocytoma cells
